multi_entity_note: Two parties: EuroTel Bratislava a.s. and Sicap Ltd, with separate addresses; also references the original Swisscom contract.
processing_note: All payments due under this Maintenance and Support contract shall be due       and payable 30 days after the invoice date, with the first invoice to be       issued on the date this Maintenance and Support contract comes into full       force and effect.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Clause 7.5 states the contract shall be effective on 06 October 2000; 10 October 2000 is the document date and 06 April 1998 is the effective date of a different (original) contract.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The contract contains no governing-law clause; Slovakia/Switzerland appear only in addresses, holidays and VAT.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: After the initial two years the contract renews automatically for a period of one year on each renewal date.
